description:
We are seeking dedicated and compassionate Registered Nurses (RNs) to join a premier home healthcare provider in Billings, MT. This is an exceptional opportunity for RNs looking for flexibility, with both full-time and part-time positions available, offering a competitive annual salary range of $115,000 - $125,000.

In this vital role, you will provide high-quality, patient-centered care in the comfort of patients' homes. You will be responsible for comprehensive assessments, medication management, wound care, and patient education, empowering individuals to achieve optimal health and independence within their own environment.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Montana
Minimum of 1-2 years of clinical nursing experience, preferably in home health
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation
Strong assessment, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $125,000, based on experience and contract type.
